description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing dependencies, parameter extraction, and request handling in FastAPI, including dependency resolution, parameter analysis, and request body processing.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: Data class holding parameter analysis details including type annotation, dependencies, and associated model field.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: Data class representing the result of dependency resolution, including values, errors, background tasks, response, and cache.

methods.name: ensure_multipart_is_installed
methods.description: Checks if 'python-multipart' is installed and correctly configured, raises RuntimeError if not.

methods.name: get_parameterless_sub_dependant
methods.description: Creates a Dependant object for a parameterless dependency.

methods.name: get_flat_dependant
methods.description: Flattens nested Dependants into a single level, merging their parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: get_flat_params
methods.description: Retrieves flattened list of ModelFields from a Dependant, including path, query, header, and cookie parameters.

methods.name: get_signature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature of a callable, with eval_str=True for Python >= 3.10.

methods.name: get_typed_signature
methods.description: Returns a signature with parameter annotations evaluated and possibly transformed.

methods.name: get_typed_annotation
methods.description: Evaluates string annotations into actual types, handling ForwardRef and evaluate_forwardref.

methods.name: get_typed_return_annotation
methods.description: Retrieves and evaluates the return annotation of a callable.

methods.name: get_dependant
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object for a given route, analyzing parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: add_non_field_param_to_dependency
methods.description: Assigns special parameter names for non-field dependencies like Request, WebSocket, Response, etc.

methods.name: analyze_param
methods.description: Analyzes a parameter's annotation, default value, and other info to determine its ModelField, dependencies, and type.

methods.name: add_param_to_fields
methods.description: Adds a ModelField to the appropriate parameter list in a Dependant based on its 'in' location.

methods.name: _solve_generator
methods.description: Handles execution of generator dependencies, entering async or sync context managers.

methods.name: solve_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a given Dependant, including nested dependencies, request parameters, and request body.

methods.name: request_params_to_args
methods.description: Converts request parameters (path, query, headers, cookies) into argument dicts for dependency functions.

methods.name: request_body_to_args
methods.description: Parses and validates request body data into dependency arguments.

methods.name: get_body_field
methods.description: Creates a ModelField representing the combined request body for a route, supporting embedded and top-level bodies.
